description: Returns a company's income statement, balance sheet and cash flow as filed with the SEC (XBRL): the last 12 calendar quarters or 6 fiscal years, each period with its filing. `statement: 'breakdowns'` gives revenue by segment, geography and product and the customers it discloses; 'outlook' its own guidance, actuals against it and an estimated next earnings date. A null is a line not filed: report it as unknown; `howToRead` in the answer says the rest. A 20-F filer has fiscal years, plus quarters from its 6-K releases (unaudited). A pre-IPO company (e.g. 'anthropic') returns its prospectus statements, by half year. Use it for revenue, earnings, balance sheet or cash flow over several periods.

basis.description: quarterly (default for a listed company: last 12 calendar quarters), half (half years: a company before its IPO only — its default) or annual (last 6 fiscal years).

statement.description: income, balance, cashflow, breakdowns (revenue by segment, geography and product, and customer concentration), outlook (the company's guidance, actuals against it, next earnings date) or all (default all).

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.

name: get_financials
title: Financial statements as filed
